title: Pacific Northwest Scala 2013 We're Doing It All Wrong by Paul Phillips
summary: Paul Phillips, a former Scala core contributor, argues after moving a million lines of code that much of what the software industry does is wrong. He critiques Scala and compiler design and calls for better approaches.
why: Cited as an insider's critique of Scala and of non-incremental compilers, often by people warning others off Scala.

quote.text: Anyone seriously considering Scala should listen to his talk
